patch_description:
Reduce parameter count from 146 to ~50-60 by implementing parameter sharing across qubits within each ansatz block. Instead of 8 independent RY parameters and 8 independent RZ parameters (per layer), use 2-3 shared parameters that apply to groups of qubits or all qubits uniformly. This maintains expressivity through 6 repetitions while dramatically improving parameter efficiency (from 0.01 to ~0.02).

The key changes:
1. Replace 8 independent RY gates with 2 shared RY parameters (applied to different qubit subsets)
2. Replace 8 independent RZ pre-gates with 1-2 shared parameters
3. Keep the CZ entanglement line (7 gates, 0 params)
4. Replace 8 independent RZ post-gates with 1-2 shared parameters
5. This reduces per-block params from 24 to ~6-8, total from 146 to ~50-60

This approach leverages the fact that we already achieve perfect accuracy, so we can trade some expressivity per block for better parameter efficiency, which is compensated by having 6 repetitions.
